content:
Hi all,

Is there some theorem for the multiplication of ideals or their powers? I'm trying to prove an exercise in Atiyah MacDonald's book and I need to be able to show the powers of (2,X) \subseteq \mathbb{Z}[X], it would also be helpful for general R algebras R[X_1,X_2, \dots] if I could have (X_1,X_2,X_3) * (X_4,X_5,X_9) or something.

Thanks!

Ryland

Ideal.span_mul_span
Submodule.span_pow (Ideal version apparently missing but they're reducibly defeq)

@loogle Ideal.span,⊢ (_ : Prop), _ * _ = Ideal.span _

should have also included _ ^ _
:search: Ideal.span_mul_span, Ideal.span_mul_span', and 4 more
